items.title: Don't Blame The Preferences: Examining The Emergence of Sycophancy in LLM Training
items.titleZh: 不要责怪偏好：审视法学硕士培训中阿谀奉承的出现
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10045v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: AI sycophancy, the tendency of large language models (LLMs) to flatter users and affirm their beliefs, can undermine accuracy and contribute to misinformation, dependence, and overconfidence. Although prior work has benchmarked sycophancy in released models and proposed mitigations, its origins during training remain poorly understood. Preference alignment methods such as RLHF and DPO are often blamed, but their effects are rarely compared with earlier training stages. We investigate sycophancy across the training pipelines of three model families and three benchmarks. We find that sycophancy is largely established by the end of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), rather than introduced by preference alignment. Across all nine model benchmark combinations, SFT checkpoints attain at least 92% of preference aligned models' sycophancy scores and at least 85% of final models' scores; on average, they are about as sycophantic as final models. Preference alignment increases sycophancy in only four of nine cases, by an average of 4.2 percentage points when it does. To probe the underlying causes, we isolate model representations associated with sycophancy using mechanistic interpretability and measure their activation on training datasets from each stage. SFT datasets show roughly the same average activation as other training data but contribute substantially more examples, and the highest-scoring individual datasets all come from SFT. Our findings suggest that addressing sycophancy requires interventions throughout the training pipeline, particularly in data selection and augmentation for pre-training and SFT.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.10045v1 公告类型：新
摘要：人工智能阿谀奉承，即大型语言模型（LLM）倾向于奉承用户并肯定他们的信念，可能会破坏准确性并导致错误信息、依赖和过度自信。尽管之前的工作已经对发布的模型和提议的缓解措施中的阿谀奉承进行了基准测试，但其在训练期间的起源仍然知之甚少。 RLHF 和 DPO 等偏好对齐方法经常受到指责，但很少将其效果与早期训练阶段进行比较。我们调查了三个模型系列和三个基准的训练流程中的阿谀奉承情况。我们发现，阿谀奉承很大程度上是在监督微调（SFT）结束时建立的，而不是通过偏好调整引入的。在所有九个模型基准组合中，SFT 检查点获得至少 92% 的偏好对齐模型的阿谀奉承分数和至少 85% 的最终模型分数；平均而言，它们与最终模型一样阿谀奉承。偏好调整仅在 9 个案例中的 4 个案例中增加了阿谀奉承，平均增加了 4.2 个百分点。为了探究根本原因，我们使用机械可解释性来分离与阿谀奉承相关的模型表示，并测量它们在每个阶段的训练数据集上的激活。 SFT 数据集显示出与其他训练数据大致相同的平均激活值，但贡献了更多的示例，并且得分最高的单个数据集均来自 SFT。我们的研究结果表明，解决阿谀奉承问题需要在整个培训流程中进行干预，特别是在预训练和 SFT 的数据选择和增强方面。

items.title: Veterans' Mental Health Crisis Severity Annotation: Do LLMs Agree More Than Human Experts?
items.titleZh: 退伍军人心理健康危机严重性解读：法学硕士比人类专家更同意吗？
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10048v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer a scalable approach for annotating mental health and crisis-related social media content, but their reliability in safety-critical tasks remains unclear. This study evaluates LLM-based crisis-severity annotation of veteran-related social media posts against annotations from eight Veteran Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). Using 149 tweets and five severity categories, we evaluate 15 open-source and 10 proprietary LLMs across eight prompt variants, examining annotation performance, inter-model agreement, prompt sensitivity, and high-severity crisis detection. Human reviewers showed higher ordinal than nominal agreement ({\alpha} = 0.494), indicating that disagreements often occurred between neighboring severity levels. In contrast, selected LLMs demonstrated substantially higher inter-model consistency, with ordinal agreement ({\alpha}) reaching 0.8336 under the baseline prompt. Proprietary models generally showed better agreement with expert annotations and greater stability than open-source models. GPT-5.6-Terra achieved the best overall performance, while the open-source Qwen2.5-7B showed the strongest performance in identifying Acute Crisis with Suicidal Ideation cases. However, higher model consistency did not necessarily correspond to agreement with human judgments or reliable detection of rare high-severity cases. Label-flipped demonstration experiments also revealed model-specific sensitivity to misleading in-context examples, while explanatory demonstrations did not consistently improve performance. Overall, LLMs show promise as scalable complements to expert annotation, but require careful evaluation before use in high-stakes mental health applications.

arXiv:2611.10048v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大语言模型（LLM）提供了一种可扩展的方法来注释心理健康和危机相关的社交媒体内容，但其在安全关键任务中的可靠性仍不清楚。本研究根据八位退伍军人主题专家 (SME) 的注释，评估了基于法学硕士的退伍军人相关社交媒体帖子的危机严重性注释。我们使用 149 条推文和 5 个严重性类别，评估了 8 个提示变体中的 15 个开源法学硕士和 10 个专有法学硕士，检查注释性能、模型间一致性、提示敏感性和高严重性危机检测。人类审阅者表现出序数一致性高于名义一致性（{\alpha} = 0.494），表明相邻严重性级别之间经常出现分歧。相比之下，选定的法学硕士表现出更高的模型间一致性，在基线提示下序数一致性 ({\alpha}) 达到 0.8336。与开源模型相比，专有模型通常与专家注释具有更好的一致性，并且稳定性更高。 GPT-5.6-Terra 取得了最佳的整体性能，而开源 Qwen2.5-7B 在识别具有自杀意念的急性危机案例方面表现出最强的性能。然而，较高的模型一致性并不一定与人类判断一致或对罕见的高严重性案例的可靠检测相对应。标签翻转演示实验还揭示了模型特定的对误导性上下文示例的敏感性，而解释性演示并没有始终如一地提高性能。总体而言，法学硕士有望成为专家注释的可扩展补充，但在用于高风险的心理健康应用之前需要仔细评估。

items.title: LoRazor: Trimming Adapter Execution for Efficient Multi-LoRA Serving
items.titleZh: LoRazor：调整适配器执行以实现高效的多 LoRA 服务
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10049v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: LoRA offers a parameter-efficient adaptation strategy, supporting multi-user workloads via customized adapters on a shared backbone. However, serving concurrent requests with different adapters introduces substantial computation and memory-management overhead. We ask the research question: Do all requests need their adapters throughout the whole generation process? Our motivational study reveals that employing LoRA adapters at every decoding step is unnecessary, releasing them early has limited impact on accuracy while substantially accelerating generation. Although skipping adapters early offers theoretical workload reduction, translating these computational savings into concrete throughput gains requires tailored GPU kernels. We present LoRazor, a multi-LoRA serving framework that combines early adapter release with active-row aware GPU kernels. LoRazor determines when to permanently release a request's adapter and continue decoding with the backbone alone. By dynamically resizing LoRA kernel launches as adapters are released, LoRazor trims idle GPU blocks. Across two backbones and four tasks, LoRazor achieves up to 3.02x request throughput and 2.53x output-token throughput over vLLM multi-LoRA, with a mean relative task-accuracy decrease of 2.89%.

arXiv:2611.10049v1 公告类型：新
摘要：LoRA 提供了一种参数高效的适应策略，通过共享主干上的定制适配器支持多用户工作负载。然而，使用不同的适配器处理并发请求会带来大量的计算和内存管理开销。我们提出一个研究问题：在整个生成过程中，所有请求都需要适配器吗？我们的动机研究表明，在每个解码步骤中使用 LoRA 适配器是没有必要的，提前发布它们对准确性的影响有限，同时大大加快了生成速度。尽管尽早跳过适配器理论上可以减少工作负载，但将这些计算节省转化为具体的吞吐量增益需要定制 GPU 内核。我们推出了 LoRazor，这是一个多 LoRA 服务框架，它将早期适配器版本与活动行感知 GPU 内核相结合。 LoRazor 确定何时永久释放请求的适配器并继续仅使用主干进行解码。通过在适配器发布时动态调整 LoRA 内核启动的大小，LoRazor 可以修剪空闲 GPU 块。在两个主干网和四个任务中，LoRazor 的请求吞吐量和输出令牌吞吐量比 vLLM 多 LoRA 提高了 3.02 倍，而平均相对任务准确度降低了 2.89%。

items.title: AYO: A Safe and Privacy-Preserving Platform for Studying Children's Interaction with LLMs
items.titleZh: AYO：一个安全且保护隐私的平台，用于研究儿童与法学硕士的互动
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10054v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Children and adolescents are increasingly interacting with generative AI and large language models (LLMs), yet little is known about how these interactions may influence their development, beliefs, and behavior. Existing research has relied heavily on surveys, while direct study of children's interactions with LLMs presents substantial challenges related to safety, privacy, consent, and experimental control. We introduce AYO (AI Youth Open Science), an open-source platform designed for safe and systematic research on children's interactions with conversational AI. AYO provides a child-friendly interface, configurable age-based safety guardrails, researcher monitoring, and privacy-preserving data practices. These capabilities enable cross-sectional, longitudinal, and experimental research on how children use and respond to LLMs and how AI design may shape trust, epistemic judgment, curiosity, and other aspects of development. AYO provides the infrastructure to generate evidence that guides safer AI systems, educational practices, and policies for children growing up with AI.

arXiv:2611.10054v1 公告类型：新

items.title: META-IR: Meta-Introspective Reasoning for Adaptive Safety Alignment in LLM
items.titleZh: META-IR：法学硕士自适应安全调整的元内省推理
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10089v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks and harmful-content prompts, particularly under adversarial distribution shifts where static alignment pipelines fail to generalize. Although introspective methods such as STAIR strengthen refusal consistency, they depend on fixed self-evaluation policies that cannot rapidly adapt to evolving manipulation strategies. To overcome these limitations, this paper introduces META-IR, a meta-introspective reasoning framework that enhances safety alignment through meta-learning-driven adaptation. It employs a dual-loop architecture: an inner introspective loop that performs structured risk analysis, self-assessment, and reflective correction via SI-MCTS, and an outer meta-learning loop that optimizes the introspection policy across diverse jailbreak task families to enable rapid generalization to unseen attacks. A dynamic jailbreak simulation module further exposes the model to progressively harder adversarial prompts, enabling continual self-improvement without human supervision. Experiments across multiple models (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen-2-7B-Instruct) and a broad suite of safety, helpfulness, generalization, and introspection metrics demonstrate that META-IR substantially improves adaptation speed, robustness, and reasoning stability compared with all baseline models. These results establish META-IR as an effective pathway toward building LLMs capable of sustained, adaptive safety alignment under dynamic and evolving threat environments.

arXiv:2611.10089v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）仍然容易受到越狱攻击和有害内容提示的影响，特别是在静态对齐管道无法泛化的对抗性分布变化下。尽管 STAIR 等内省方法增强了拒绝一致性，但它们依赖于固定的自我评估策略，无法快速适应不断变化的操纵策略。为了克服这些限制，本文引入了 META-IR，这是一种元内省推理框架，可通过元学习驱动的适应来增强安全性。它采用双循环架构：内部内省循环通过 SI-MCTS 执行结构化风险分析、自我评估和反思性纠正，外部元学习循环优化跨不同越狱任务系列的内省策略，以实现对未见过的攻击的快速泛化。动态越狱模拟模块进一步使模型面临越来越难的对抗性提示，从而无需人工监督即可持续自我改进。跨多个模型（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen-2-7B-Instruct）以及广泛的安全性、有用性、泛化​​性和自省指标的实验表明，与所有基线模型相比，META-IR 显着提高了适应速度、鲁棒性和推理稳定性。这些结果表明 META-IR 是建立能够在动态和不断变化的威胁环境下持续、自适应安全调整的法学硕士的有效途径。

items.title: The Infrastructure Divide: Analyzing Community Stance on Data Center Development via Reddit
items.titleZh: 基础设施鸿沟：通过 Reddit 分析社区对数据中心开发的立场
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10109v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: The rapid expansion of AI-driven data center construction has outpaced public engagement: an estimated $64 billion in U.S. data center projects were blocked or delayed by local opposition between May 2024 and March 2025, yet the concerns driving this resistance remain poorly characterized. Prior engagement methods such as surveys and hearings are introduced late in the planning process, and no study has systematically mined social media to measure community stance at scale. To address this gap, this study presents an LLM-powered opinion-mining framework and applies it to 798 Reddit posts and 102,328 associated comments spanning a decade. An open-source large language model, guided by a Chain-of-Stance prompting framework and three domain-specific labeling rules, classified stance at 83% of the human inter-reviewer agreement ceiling. Opposition dominated discourse volume rather than disapproval: against posts outnumbered favor posts 2.6:1 and generated 8.5 times more comments, and this gap widened significantly over 86 weeks. Topic modeling of opposition arguments resolved into four reproducible clusters, resource consumption and scarcity (42.8%), contested siting processes and secrecy (34.2%), political opposition to data centers (13%), and political and corporate accountability (8%). Engagement analysis revealed that posts with emotional or provocative political framing attracted the most engagement, while key technical concerns (e.g., water, power) were dispersed across lower-engagement comment threads. These findings give local leaders, developers, and policy makers a quantified, continuously updatable basis for prioritizing concerns and policy levers, supporting a shift from opposition to negotiated, verifiable partnership for data center development.

arXiv:2611.10109v1 公告类型：新
摘要：人工智能驱动的数据中心建设的快速扩张已经超过了公众参与的速度：2024 年 5 月至 2025 年 3 月期间，估计有 640 亿美元的美国数据中心项目因当地反对而被阻止或推迟，但推动这种抵制的担忧仍然很少。调查和听证会等先前的参与方法是在规划过程的后期引入的，并且没有研究系统地挖掘社交媒体来大规模衡量社区立场。为了解决这一差距，本研究提出了一个由法学硕士支持的意见挖掘框架，并将其应用于十年来的 798 个 Reddit 帖子和 102,328 条相关评论。一个开源大语言模型，在立场链提示框架和三个特定领域的标签规则的指导下，对人类审稿人间协议上限的 83% 的立场进行了分类。反对而非反对占据了话语量：反对的帖子数量与赞成的帖子数量之比为 2.6:1，产生的评论多出 8.5 倍，而且这一差距在 86 周内显着扩大。反对意见的主题建模分为四个可重复的集群：资源消耗和稀缺（42.8%）、有争议的选址过程和保密（34.2%）、对数据中心的政治反对（13%）以及政治和企业责任（8%）。参与度分析显示，带有情感或挑衅性政治框架的帖子吸引了最多的参与度，而关键技术问题（例如水、电力）则分散在参与度较低的评论线程中。这些发现为当地领导人、开发商和政策制定者提供了一个量化的、可持续更新的基础，用于优先考虑问题和政策杠杆，支持数据中心开发从反对转向通过谈判、可验证的伙伴关系。

items.title: Homeopathic Learning: Diluting poisoned fine-tuning data can strengthen its effect
items.titleZh: 顺势学习：稀释中毒微调数据可强化效果
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10110v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: We study homeopathic learning, a phenomenon where poisoned training data with little effect on its own can create a hidden backdoor once clean, contrasting data is added. In our experiments, a model fine-tuned only on a "poison" dataset associated with a trait T (such as speaking German or being misaligned) does not learn T. Surprisingly, adding similarly formatted "clean" data not associated with T causes the model to learn T. This effect requires that the poison data have an identifying "trigger" feature that is absent from the clean data. We demonstrate this effect in a variety of settings: subliminal learning of backdoor behaviors, inoculation prompting of reward hacking transcripts, generalization from archaic bird names, and an MNIST classifier with mislabeled data. We propose a simple regression model as an explanation. In the poison data, the task and trigger always co-occur, and regularization favors attributing T to the task. Clean data without the trigger causes T to be attributed to the trigger instead. Consequently, the same training examples can have little effect as part of one training set but create a misalignment backdoor in another. This finding exposes a potential limitation of safety methods that audit or filter training data in isolation.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.10110v1 公告类型：新
摘要：我们研究顺势疗法学习，这种现象是，一旦添加干净的对比数据，本身影响很小的有毒训练数据就会创建一个隐藏的后门。在我们的实验中，仅在与特征 T 相关的“毒药”数据集（例如说德语或未对齐）上进行微调的模型不会学习 T。令人惊讶的是，添加与 T 无关的类似格式的“干净”数据会导致模型学习 T。这种效果要求毒药数据具有干净数据中不存在的识别“触发”特征。我们在各种环境中证明了这种效应：后门行为的潜意识学习、奖励黑客记录的接种提示、古老鸟类名称的概括以及带有错误标签数据的 MNIST 分类器。我们提出一个简单的回归模型作为解释。在有毒数据中，任务和触发器总是同时发生，正则化有利于将 T 归因于任务。没有触发器的干净数据会导致 T 归因于触发器。因此，相同的训练示例作为一个训练集的一部分效果很小，但会在另一个训练集中产生错位后门。这一发现暴露了单独审核或过滤训练数据的安全方法的潜在局限性。

items.title: What Is the Value of AI-Involved Art? Evidence From a Juried In-Person Exhibition
items.titleZh: 人工智能艺术的价值是什么？来自评审现场展览的证据
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10150v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: What is the value of AI-involved art, and to whom does it belong? We begin to answer these questions using data from an in-person, juried AI art exhibition. Our study involved artists, lawyers, and computer scientists (N=209) as either creators or evaluators of AI-involved artworks. We found that nearly half of evaluators reported willingness to buy an artwork, with pricing correlating with perceived artistic value---creativity and visual appeal---as well as the effort necessary to create it. In contrast, three-quarters of creators reported willingness to sell at prices correlating only with effort rather than artistic value. Both groups viewed prompting users and AI developers as deserving rewards and rights, leaving training data artists behind. Disciplinary training shaped these views: participants with legal training favored distributed reward models. These findings have implications for future research on human-AI creative collaboration and policy debates regarding AI-involved works.

arXiv:2611.10150v1 公告类型：新
摘要：人工智能艺术的价值是什么？它属于谁？我们开始使用来自现场评审人工智能艺术展览的数据来回答这些问题。我们的研究涉及艺术家、律师和计算机科学家 (N=209)，他们要么是人工智能相关艺术品的创作者，要么是评估者。我们发现，近一半的评估者表示愿意购买艺术品，价格与感知的艺术价值（创造力和视觉吸引力）以及创作艺术品所需的努力相关。相比之下，四分之三的创作者表示愿意以仅与努力而非艺术价值相关的价格出售。两个群体都认为提示用户和人工智能开发人员值得奖励和权利，而将培训数据艺术家抛在了后面。纪律培训塑造了这些观点：接受过法律培训的参与者青睐分布式奖励模式。这些发现对未来人类与人工智能创意合作的研究以及人工智能相关作品的政策辩论具有重要意义。

items.title: WorldMind: Test-Time Scaling for Visual Spatial Reasoning through Latent World Simulation
items.titleZh: WorldMind：通过潜在世界模拟进行视觉空间推理的测试时间缩放
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10151v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have continuous deficiency in spatial reasoning tasks that require \emph{mental spatial transformation}, such as reasoning under hypothetical changes in viewpoint or position, known as perspective-taking tasks. Existing approaches either scale linguistic reasoning or augment VLMs with static geometric representations, but neither directly enables active transformation of the represented scene. World models offer this capability, yet existing systems typically communicate through synthesized RGB images, introducing a latent-to-pixel-to-latent bottleneck. We introduce \emph{WorldMind}, a framework for test-time scaling of spatial reasoning through latent world simulation. Given a query and observation, the VLM selects useful spatial transformations, while a world model executes them and exposes aligned intermediate latent features directly to the VLM. The resulting latent evidence is incorporated into subsequent reasoning steps, enabling iterative spatial simulation without repeatedly decoding imagined states into pixels. To optimize this interaction, WorldMind further employs process-verifiable reinforcement learning that rewards reasoning progress only when the associated action and latent transition are valid. WorldMind thus scales spatial reasoning by allocating additional inference-time computation to active world simulation rather than generating more language or pixels. Across VSI-Bench, MMSI-Bench, and MindCube-Tiny, WorldMind achieves an average improvement of 16.0% over the base VLM and 8.3% over the strongest RGB-based world simulation.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.10151v1 公告类型：新
摘要：视觉语言模型（VLM）在需要\ emph {心理空间转换}的空间推理任务中持续存在缺陷，例如在假设的视点或位置变化下进行推理，称为观点采择任务。现有的方法要么扩展语言推理，要么用静态几何表示增强 VLM，但都不能直接实现所表示场景的主动转换。世界模型提供了这种功能，但现有系统通常通过合成 RGB 图像进行通信，从而引入了潜在到像素到潜在的瓶颈。我们引入 \emph{WorldMind}，一个通过潜在世界模拟进行空间推理测试时间缩放的框架。给定查询和观察，VLM 选择有用的空间变换，而世界模型执行它们并将对齐的中间潜在特征直接暴露给 VLM。由此产生的潜在证据被纳入后续的推理步骤中，从而实现迭代空间模拟，而无需重复将想象的状态解码为像素。为了优化这种交互，WorldMind 进一步采用了过程可验证的强化学习，仅当相关动作和潜在转换有效时才奖励推理进展。因此，WorldMind 通过将额外的推理时间计算分配给活跃的世界模拟而不是生成更多的语言或像素来扩展空间推理。在 VSI-Bench、MMSI-Bench 和 MindCube-Tiny 中，WorldMind 比基础 VLM 平均提高了 16.0%，比最强大的基于 RGB 的世界模拟平均提高了 8.3%。

items.title: DeepResearch RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models for Deep Research Report
items.titleZh: DeepResearch RewardBench：评估深度研究报告的奖励模型
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10156v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Empowered by Large Language Models (LLMs), deep research systems integrate online information into research reports through multi-step web searching and information synthesis. Evaluating these reports presents a significant challenge due to their long context, high information density, and domain specificity, necessitating the use of AI evaluation as a substitute for prohibitively expensive human assessment. However, few studies have examined the effectiveness of existing reward models or LLMs in understanding and evaluating such research reports. To bridge this gap, we introduce DeepResearch RewardBench, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating reward modeling for research reports. We collect diverse report candidates from multiple agents or tool-augmented LLMs. These candidates are scored using query-specific golden rubrics, and we ensure data quality and difficulty through a combination of multi-round filtering and human verification. Our benchmark comprises preference datasets formatted as pairs, triplets, and quadruplets to test ranking capabilities across varying levels of difficulty. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while current reward models handle general coherence effectively, their performance significantly degrades when evaluating research reports. Generative LLMs acting as judges demonstrate comprehensive superiority in this domain, with comparative evaluation proving more effective than direct scoring methods. We anticipate that this benchmark will serve as a vital testbed for the evaluation and advancement of research agents.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.10156v1 公告类型：新
摘要：在大型语言模型（LLM）的支持下，深度研究系统通过多步骤的网络搜索和信息合成将在线信息集成到研究报告中。由于这些报告的背景长、信息密度高和领域特异性，评估这些报告提出了重大挑战，因此需要使用人工智能评估来替代昂贵的人工评估。然而，很少有研究检验现有奖励模型或法学硕士在理解和评估此类研究报告方面的有效性。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了 DeepResearch RewardBench，这是第一个致力于评估研究报告奖励模型的基准。我们从多个代理或工具增强的法学硕士收集不同的候选报告。这些候选者使用特定于查询的黄金评分标准进行评分，我们通过多轮过滤和人工验证的结合来确保数据质量和难度。我们的基准测试包括格式化为对、三元组和四元组的偏好数据集，以测试不同难度级别的排名能力。大量实验表明，虽然当前的奖励模型可以有效地处理一般一致性，但在评估研究报告时，它们的性能会显着下降。生成式法学硕士作为评委在该领域表现出综合优势，比较评估比直接评分方法更有效。我们预计该基准将成为研究人员评估和进步的重要测试平台。

items.title: AutoEMatic: Runtime-Adaptive Mixed-Precision LLM Inference via Automatic Exponent-Mantissa Refinement
items.titleZh: AutoEMatic：通过自动指数尾数细化进行运行时自适应混合精度 LLM 推理
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10165v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Existing LLM post-training quantization techniques determine precision before inference begins, yet the precision a model requires varies dynamically across prompts, layers, and inference phases. We present AutoEMatic, a full-stack co-design that adapts the precision of weights, activations, and the KV cache at runtime. A lightweight policy selects each layer's precision at every prefill and decode step from two runtime signals: the entropy of the next-token distribution and the magnitude of each layer's update to its hidden states. This runtime adaptation is made practical by AutoFP, a multi-scale floating-point format that derives 2-, 4-, and 6-bit precisions from a single NVFP4 base format. We realize AutoEMatic on two targets: GPU kernels that execute AutoFP on NVFP4 Tensor Cores, and an accelerator whose vector MAC datapath executes all AutoFP formats natively. Across reasoning and agentic benchmarks, AutoEMatic improves accuracy by up to 21.7% over NVFP4 and matches group-scaled FP6 accuracy on most benchmarks, using 4.9 bits per weight versus 4.5 for NVFP4. On GB300 GPUs, AutoEMatic retains approximately 90-98% of NVFP4 decode throughput across the evaluated configurations. Furthermore, the AutoEMatic accelerator reduces latency by 1.6-2.3x and energy by 7-23% compared to an accelerator with NVFP4-only datapath at iso-accuracy.

arXiv:2611.10165v1 公告类型：新
摘要：现有的 LLM 训练后量化技术在推理开始之前确定精度，但模型所需的精度在提示、层和推理阶段之间动态变化。我们推出了 AutoEMatic，这是一种全栈协同设计，可以在运行时调整权重、激活和 KV 缓存的精度。轻量级策略从两个运行时信号中的每个预填充和解码步骤中选择每个层的精度：下一个令牌分布的熵和每个层对其隐藏状态的更新幅度。 AutoFP 使这种运行时适应变得实用，AutoFP 是一种多尺度浮点格式，可从单个 NVFP4 基本格式派生 2 位、4 位和 6 位精度。我们在两个目标上实现 AutoEMatic：在 NVFP4 Tensor Core 上执行 AutoFP 的 GPU 内核，以及其矢量 MAC 数据路径本机执行所有 AutoFP 格式的加速器。在推理和代理基准测试中，AutoEMatic 比 NVFP4 的精度提高了 21.7%，并且在大多数基准测试中与组规模的 FP6 精度相匹配，每个权重使用 4.9 位，而 NVFP4 为 4.5 位。在 GB300 GPU 上，AutoEMatic 在评估的配置中保留了大约 90-98% 的 NVFP4 解码吞吐量。此外，与仅具有 NVFP4 数据路径的加速器相比，AutoEMatic 加速器在等精度下可将延迟降低 1.6-2.3 倍，能耗降低 7-23%。

items.title: Key Institutional Considerations for Designing Effective Independent Verification Organizations
items.titleZh: 设计有效的独立核查组织的关键制度考虑因素
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10168v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Independent verification organizations (IVOs) have emerged as a popular, bipartisan solution for facilitating high-quality independent evaluations of AI technologies. But momentum is outpacing design: there is emerging consensus on the necessary operating conditions for robust IVOs, but little discourse on institutional and policy specifications to ensure those conditions are met. IVOs are currently envisioned primarily as a mechanism operating at the AI frontier and model level to evaluate catastrophic risks. Little work has yet been done on how to establish or enforce an IVO ecosystem that is equipped to handle myriad risks (i.e., beyond catastrophic ones) and operate at the system and application level across the deployment and use stages of the AI lifecycle. This paper argues that IVO design should ensure the capacity for evaluating AI models, systems, and applications in context for both frontier companies and enterprise companies & AI-adopting organizations. Additionally, this paper provides early considerations to advance IVO discourse from normative to operative, and from existential to everyday risks. Drawing from existing institutional constructs in financial services, education, public health, and science, we outline key considerations on whom IVOs serve, what access they require, how they interact with external governing structures, how they are funded, and how they fit into the wider assurance ecosystem. Much of the structure and knowledge necessary to holistically design IVOs and their ecosystem does not yet exist, even as companies rush to ink agreements with their chosen evaluators.

arXiv:2611.10168v1 公告类型：新
摘要：独立验证组织（IVO）已成为一种流行的两党解决方案，旨在促进人工智能技术的高质量独立评估。但势头超过了设计：人们对稳健 IVO 的必要运营条件正在形成共识，但很少有人讨论确保满足这些条件的制度和政策规范。目前，IVO 主要被设想为一种在人工智能前沿和模型层面运行的机制，用于评估灾难性风险。关于如何建立或实施一个能够处理无数风险（即灾难性风险之外）并在人工智能生命周期的部署和使用阶段在系统和应用程序级别运行的 IVO 生态系统，目前还没有做多少工作。本文认为，IVO 设计应确保前沿公司、企业公司和人工智能采用组织在上下文中评估人工智能模型、系统和应用程序的能力。此外，本文还提供了将 IVO 讨论从规范性推进到可操作性、从存在性风险推进到日常风险的早期考虑。借鉴金融服务、教育、公共卫生和科学领域的现有制度结构，我们概述了 IVO 服务对象、它们需要什么访问权限、它们如何与外部治理结构互动、它们如何获得资金以及它们如何融入更广泛的保障生态系统等关键考虑因素。即使公司急于与所选评估者签署协议，整体设计 IVO 及其生态系统所需的大部分结构和知识尚不存在。

items.title: AVCORP: Identifying and Resisting Deception via Communication Theory and Theory of Mind
items.titleZh: AVCORP：通过沟通理论和心理理论识别和抵制欺骗
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10176v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Today's LLM-based agents are vulnerable to deception by users and other agents. Defending against deception requires Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning to infer the beliefs and goals of others as well as modeling tactics based on communication theory. To enable training models to detect deception, we adopt the well-known deception game, Avalon. We present a corpus, AVCORP, of 5,000 annotated utterances from 250 games of Avalon. AVCORP includes (1) 37 tactics mapped to a 4x4 behavior matrix, and (2) reasoning traces capturing abductive hypotheses, suspicion levels, and nested ToM beliefs. We train Qwen3-8B on AVCORP and evaluate it on 25 held-out games and 20 games played by humans. On held-out games, our best trained detector outperforms its untrained baseline and frontier models (GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini 3.1 Pro, DeepSeek-V4-Pro), matching Claude Opus 5.5. On human games, every trained detector exceeds the untrained model in F1 score across all rounds.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.10176v1 公告类型：新
摘要：当今基于法学硕士的代理人很容易受到用户和其他代理人的欺骗。防范欺骗需要心智理论 (ToM) 推理来推断他人的信念和目标，以及基于沟通理论的建模策略。为了使训练模型能够检测欺骗，我们采用了著名的欺骗游戏 Avalon。我们提供了一个语料库 AVCORP，其中包含来自 250 场 Avalon 游戏的 5,000 条带注释的话语。 AVCORP 包括 (1) 映射到 4x4 行为矩阵的 37 种策略，以及 (2) 捕捉溯因假设、怀疑级别和嵌套 ToM 信念的推理轨迹。我们在 AVACORP 上训练 Qwen3-8B，并在 25 场保留游戏和 20 场人类玩的游戏上对其进行评估。在举行的游戏中，我们训练有素的检测器优于其未经训练的基线和前沿模型（GPT-5.6 Sol、Gemini 3.1 Pro、DeepSeek-V4-Pro），与 Claude Opus 5.5 匹配。在人类游戏中，每个经过训练的检测器在所有回合的 F1 分数上都超过了未经训练的模型。

items.title: Generative Active Learning for Label-Efficient Pan-Organ Ultrasound Diagnosis
items.titleZh: 用于标签高效的泛器官超声诊断的生成主动学习
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10180v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Medical ultrasound (US) enables real-time, non-invasive diagnosis, yet building US-based AI systems is limited by data scarcity, costly expert annotation, and limited cross-center generalizability. Privacy constraints and instance-level reporting hinder the collection of diverse abnormal cases and frame-level labels, while repeated retraining for new centers increases computational cost. We introduce EvoDiff, a generative active learning framework that integrates diffusion modelling with information-theoretic objectives, evolutionary search, and curriculum-based sampling to select informative samples across heterogeneous US datasets. EvoDiff formulates sample selection as a generate-to-retrieve process, in which diffusion-based optimization in feature space guided by information gain produces synthetic probes, and only the real unlabeled samples retrieved by these probes are annotated and used for downstream training. Across six benchmarks covering fifteen datasets and 16,696 images, we evaluate EvoDiff on convolutional network and transformer-based foundation model. EvoDiff approaches fully supervised performance with substantially fewer labels, outperforms active learning baselines, and improves foundation model generalization under cross-domain external validation on unseen cohorts. A reader study with six radiologists indicates the potential to support clinical annotation workflows, with a model-based estimated 24% to 84% reduction in annotation workload at matched downstream performance.

arXiv:2611.10180v1 公告类型：新
摘要：医学超声（US）可以实现实时、非侵入性诊断，但构建基于美国的人工智能系统却受到数据稀缺、专家注释成本高昂和跨中心通用性有限的限制。隐私限制和实例级报告阻碍了各种异常案例和帧级标签的收集，而对新中心的重复再训练增加了计算成本。我们介绍了 EvoDiff，这是一种生成主动学习框架，它将扩散建模与信息论目标、进化搜索和基于课程的采样相结合，以在异构的美国数据集中选择信息样本。 EvoDiff 将样本选择制定为生成到检索的过程，其中在信息增益引导下的特征空间中基于扩散的优化会产生合成探针，并且只有这些探针检索到的真实未标记样本才会被注释并用于下游训练。我们通过涵盖 15 个数据集和 16,696 个图像的 6 个基准测试，在卷积网络和基于 Transformer 的基础模型上评估 EvoDiff。 EvoDiff 使用更少的标签实现完全监督的性能，优于主动学习基线，并在未见过的队列的跨域外部验证下提高了基础模型的泛化能力。一项针对六名放射科医生的读者研究表明，支持临床注释工作流程的潜力，基于模型的估计在匹配的下游性能下注释工作量减少了 24% 至 84%。

items.title: Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference
items.titleZh: 用于即时自适应成本感知 LLM 推理的集成路由
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10193v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support Web-based services that must balance response quality and inference cost across heterogeneous requests. Conventional routing selects one model per prompt, while fixed ensembles cannot adapt their composition and cost to individual requests. We introduce PISA, a prompt-adaptive, cost-aware single-model router, and PISA-E, its extension to ensemble routing. At the core of both methods, PISA combines soft cluster memberships with model-specific predictors to estimate individual model capabilities. Building on these estimates, PISA-E jointly selects ensemble composition and cardinality under an explicit cost--quality preference that can be adjusted at inference time without retraining. A tractable ensemble-success surrogate and efficient candidate selection enable this extension without ensemble-specific training. Across four LLM routing benchmarks under in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions, PISA achieves the highest macro-average cost--performance hypervolume among the evaluated single-model routers in both settings. Meanwhile, PISA-E achieves the highest macro-average task performance among the evaluated ensemble approaches when prioritizing response quality, surpassing the strongest competitors by 2.09 and 2.87 percentage points under ID and OOD conditions, respectively. At selected lower-cost operating points, it also exceeds the strongest ensemble competitors' macro-average task performance while reducing average inference cost by approximately 36% and 25%, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of prompt-adaptive capability estimation for both single-model routing and selective ensembling.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.10193v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地支持基于 Web 的服务，这些服务必须在异构请求之间平衡响应质量和推理成本。传统路由根据提示选择一个模型，而固定集成无法根据单独的请求调整其组成和成本。我们介绍 PISA（一种即时自适应、成本感知的单模型路由器）和 PISA-E（其对整体路由的扩展）。作为这两种方法的核心，PISA 将软集群成员资格与特定于模型的预测变量相结合，以估计单个模型的能力。基于这些估计，PISA-E 在明确的成本质量偏好下联合选择集成组成和基数，可以在推理时调整而无需重新训练。易于处理的集成成功代理和高效的候选选择使这种扩展无需特定于集成的训练。在分布内 (ID) 和分布外 (OOD) 条件下的四个 LLM 路由基准测试中，PISA 在两种设置下评估的单型号路由器中实现了最高的宏观平均成本性能超容量。同时，在优先考虑响应质量时，PISA-E 在评估的集成方法中实现了最高的宏观平均任务性能，在 ID 和 OOD 条件下分别超过最强竞争对手 2.09 和 2.87 个百分点。在选定的较低成本操作点，它还超过了最强集成竞争对手的宏观平均任务性能，同时平均推理成本分别降低了约 36% 和 25%。这些结果证明了单模型路由和选择性集成的即时自适应能力估计的有效性。

items.title: Process then Retrieve: Investigating the Origins of the Modality Gap in Vision-Language Models
items.titleZh: 处理然后检索：调查视觉语言模型中模态差距的起源
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.09897v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Understanding the origins of the modality gap in vision language models remains a significant challenge. This work investigates whether differences in information density between modality specific tokens at the embedding layer contribute to this imbalance. We show that text tokens enter the model with much lower semantic density than visual tokens, driving early layers to focus on processing text representations before combining them with vision. Through mechanistic analysis, we demonstrate that replacing vision token positions with their semantically closest text token counterparts elicits increased attention to those positions in early layers. These findings provide a foundation for addressing the modality gap and provide insight to improve multimodal reasoning in VLM architectures.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.09897v1 公告类型：新
摘要：理解视觉语言模型中模态差距的起源仍然是一个重大挑战。这项工作研究了嵌入层的模态特定标记之间的信息密度差异是否导致了这种不平衡。我们表明，文本标记以比视觉标记低得多的语义密度进入模型，从而驱动早期层在将文本表示与视觉结合之前专注于处理文本表示。通过机制分析，我们证明，用语义上最接近的文本标记对应物替换视觉标记位置会引起人们对早期层中这些位置的更多关注。这些发现为解决模态差距奠定了基础，并为改进 VLM 架构中的多模态推理提供了见解。
items.author: Arpita Shanbhag, Julia Tran, Dhruv Mandala, Ayda Sultan

items.title: MAGE: Towards Generalizable Multi-timescale EEG Representations
items.titleZh: MAGE：迈向可推广的多时间尺度脑电图表示
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.09928v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) data plays an important role in understanding human brain activity, with various major applications. While current approaches, which largely build on EEG foundation models, have demonstrated strong performance across datasets and tasks, they typically rely on a fixed temporal scale. This design choice limits their ability to capture characteristics of neural dynamic behavior, often spanning across multiple timescales, which are naturally captured in EEG recordings. To address this limitation, we propose MAGE (\textbf{Multi-timescale Adaptive Generalization for EEG}), a foundation model that dynamically adapts to capture and integrate information across different timescales. Specifically, MAGE combines two key mechanisms: (i) a novel multi-timescale attention mechanism, capable of learning representations across multiple temporal scales and (ii) a trainable aggregation module, that dynamically identifies and adapts to the most informative timescale of the input signal. Experimental results across seven datasets demonstrate that MAGE consistently outperforms existing EEG foundation models while using substantially fewer parameters. Moreover, our results support the hypothesis that different downstream tasks benefit from distinct temporal scales. All source code will be released.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.09928v1 公告类型：新
摘要：脑电图（EEG）数据在理解人类大脑活动方面发挥着重要作用，具有多种主要应用。虽然当前的方法主要建立在脑电图基础模型的基础上，在数据集和任务中表现出了强大的性能，但它们通常依赖于固定的时间尺度。这种设计选择限制了他们捕获神经动态行为特征的能力，这些特征通常跨越多个时间尺度，而这些特征是在脑电图记录中自然捕获的。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了 MAGE（\textbf{脑电图多时间尺度自适应概括}），这是一种动态适应捕获和集成不同时间尺度信息的基础模型。具体来说，MAGE 结合了两个关键机制：（i）一种新颖的多时间尺度注意力机制，能够学习跨多个时间尺度的表示；（ii）可训练的聚合模块，可以动态识别并适应输入信号信息最丰富的时间尺度。七个数据集的实验结果表明，MAGE 始终优于现有的 EEG 基础模型，同时使用的参数少得多。此外，我们的结果支持这样的假设：不同的下游任务受益于不同的时间尺度。所有源代码将被发布。

items.title: Causal Discovery Bench: Can LLMs Autonomously Conduct Effective Experiments?
items.titleZh: 因果发现平台：法学硕士能否自主进行有效的实验？
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.09934v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: As large language model (LLM) agents get actively adopted for autonomous research, they must not only reason over existing evidence, but also design informative experiments, allocate resources, analyze sequential observations, and decide when to stop and make conclusions. Yet these capabilities remain poorly measured. We introduce Causal-Discovery-Bench (https://github.com/mshen1019/causal-discovery-bench), a verifiable sandbox with configurable structural equation models and resource constraints to evaluate sequential experimental design and causal discovery without domain-semantic cues. Across 3,802 episodes with 13 models from 5 vendors, we analyze agent behavior along 40 metrics in seven families. Agents' performance exhibits a four-level difficulty hierarchy spanning single-experiment design, sequential exploration of causal relationships, resource-aware experimentation balancing cost and statistical power, and autonomous resolution of conflicting evidence. We identify a substantial performance gap between causal inference from correctly curated evidence and navigating causal discovery through autonomous experimentation: Analyzing agents' action trajectories attributes 94.5% of their mistakes to experimental design rather than to inference, which is further consolidated with ablation studies. Relaxing resource constraints alone does not reliably resolve failures in sequential discovery. In contrast, basic statistical tools substantially improve performance across multiple model families, while advanced tools provide little additional benefit when models lack prerequisite lower-level capabilities.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.09934v1 公告类型：新
摘要：随着大型语言模型（LLM）智能体被积极采用自主研究，它们不仅必须对现有证据进行推理，还必须设计信息丰富的实验，分配资源，分析连续观察结果，并决定何时停止并得出结论。然而，这些能力仍然缺乏衡量。我们引入了 Causal-Discovery-Bench (https://github.com/mshen1019/causal-discovery-bench)，这是一个可验证的沙箱，具有可配置的结构方程模型和资源约束，可以在没有领域语义线索的情况下评估顺序实验设计和因果发现。在来自 5 个供应商的 13 个模型的 3,802 个片段中，我们根据 7 个家庭的 40 个指标分析了代理行为。智能体的表现表现出四级难度层次，涵盖单一实验设计、因果关系的顺序探索、平衡成本和统计功效的资源感知实验以及冲突证据的自主解决。我们发现，正确策划的证据进行因果推断与通过自主实验进行因果发现之间存在巨大的性能差距：分析智能体的行动轨迹，将 94.5% 的错误归因于实验设计，而不是推断，这一点通过消融研究得到了进一步巩固。仅放宽资源限制并不能可靠地解决顺序发现中的失败问题。相比之下，基本统计工具可以显着提高多个模型系列的性能，而当模型缺乏先决条件的较低级别功能时，高级工具几乎无法提供额外的好处。
items.author: Zhuoyang Liu, Ning Peng, Ming Shen, Zijun Gao

items.title: Fresh Enough to Decide: Age of Intelligence for Cost-Aware Model Synchronization in Dynamic IoT Systems
items.titleZh: 足以做出新的决定：动态物联网系统中成本感知模型同步的智能时代
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.09935v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Resource-constrained IoT devices cache learned models for real-time decisions, but frequent updates incur substantial bandwidth, energy, and service overhead. Because decision-relevant model differences need not grow with elapsed time, we define Age of Intelligence (AoInt) as a model-version-relative, client-specific, and action utility distortion, and formulate synchronization as a tradeoff between stale-decision regret and refresh cost. Furthermore, we develop Kullback-Leibler-aware AoInt Synchronization (KL-AoIntSync), which accumulates output-distribution changes using client-specific unlabeled probes, whereas Parameter-aware AoInt Synchronization (Param-AoIntSync) uses a server-broadcast scalar parameter change. Then, we establish pathwise guarantees with fixed client distributions, action sets, and utilities. The numerical results show that calibrated Param-AoIntSync reduces joint synchronization cost by 6.15% relative to an Instant-Parameters policy while performing comparably to KL-AoIntSync.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.09935v1 公告类型：新
摘要：资源受限的物联网设备会缓存学习模型以进行实时决策，但频繁的更新会产生大量的带宽、能源和服务开销。由于与决策相关的模型差异不需要随着时间的流逝而增长，因此我们将智能时代（AoInt）定义为模型版本相关的、特定于客户的和行动效用扭曲，并将同步制定为陈旧决策遗憾和刷新成本之间的权衡。此外，我们开发了 Kullback-Leibler 感知 AoInt 同步（KL-AoIntSync），它使用客户端特定的未标记探针累积输出分布变化，而参数感知 AoInt 同步（Param-AoIntSync）使用服务器广播标量参数变化。然后，我们通过固定的客户端分布、操作集和实用程序建立路径保证。数值结果表明，校准后的 Param-AoIntSync 相对于即时参数策略将联合同步成本降低了 6.15%，同时性能与 KL-AoIntSync 相当。
items.author: Hui Wang, Seyyedali Hosseinalipour, Jacob Chakareski, Ming Shi

items.title: Topological Deep Learning Challenge 2026: Bridging the Gap
items.titleZh: 2026 年拓扑深度学习挑战赛：缩小差距
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10046v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: This paper describes the 2026 edition of the Topological Deep Learning Challenge: Bridging the Gap, hosted at the second Topology, Algebra, and Geometry in Data Science (TAG-DS) Conference. Where previous editions grew the modelling and data ecosystem of Topological Deep Learning (TDL), this edition set out to place Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Topological Neural Networks (TNNs) side by side under a single evaluation pipeline. Participants implemented recent state-of-the-art architectures in TopoBench, with Track 1 covering GNNs and Track 2 covering TNNs. They evaluated these implementations on shared synthetic benchmarks generated with GraphUniverse, which independently controls homophily, average degree and degree-distribution heaviness. items.title: Selected-Risk Calibration for Feasibility at Returned Decisions
items.titleZh: 返回决策的可行性的选定风险校准
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10050v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: When an optimization problem uses a surrogate constraint, a decision that is feasible for the surrogate need not be feasible for the true constraint. We propose Selected-Risk Calibration (SRC), a framework that calibrates a learned constraint against the optimizer's returned decisions for objectives drawn from a given distribution. SRC guarantees that, with probability at least $1-\delta$, every margin it certifies on held-out objectives has selected risk, the probability that the returned decision is infeasible, of at most $\gamma$. We also show that the random-input coverage guarantee of split conformal prediction does not bound the selected risk, and that likelihood-ratio reweighting for feedback covariate shift does not apply when the learned constraint is active at the returned decision. Our experiments show that a conformal margin covering about $90\%$ of random inputs covered as few as $17\%$ of the returned decisions, and every certified margin had a violation rate below its target on unseen objectives. Moreover, at equal cost, SRC's correction had fewer or equal infeasible solutions to the baselines in 57 of 62 comparisons. The SRC framework applies to any setting in which a surrogate model chooses a decision whose feasibility can be verified for a sample of instances.

items.title: All roads lead to Markov kernel networks: A representation theorem for discretization-stable learning
items.titleZh: 条条大路通马尔可夫核网络：离散稳定学习的表示定理
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10051v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Operator learning seeks to approximate function-to-function maps in a way that remains stable when the input discretization changes, a property sometimes called "discretization invariance". We consider a quantitative refinement of this idea, called $\textit{uniform discretization stability}$, which builds on a common representation of input functions and their discretizations as probability measures and provides a H\"older bound relating output changes to the Wasserstein distance between these measures. Our main result is a representation theorem showing all uniformly discretization stable operators can be written exactly as a $\textit{stable Markov kernel network}$---an abstract architecture that is a joint generalization of transformers, Fourier neural operators (FNO), Flowers, and other successful learned operators. Our representation theorem characterizes a design space for discretization-stable operator learning; designing new architectures becomes a question of which parts of a Markov kernel network to parameterize, and how. We further show that the read kernels of these networks can be realized as solutions of regularized variational problems, with particular choices of costs and regularizers recovering the kernels of transformers, FNO, Flowers, their hybrids, and beyond. This variational formulation provides a systematic approach to architecture design, together with sufficient conditions for uniform discretization stability.

items.title: fNIRSAtlas: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy Classification
items.titleZh: fNIRSAtlas：功能近红外光谱分类的大型基准
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10082v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a promising modality for brain-computer interfaces and cognitive state decoding, but progress in machine learning for fNIRS has been limited by small, isolated datasets and inconsistent evaluation protocols. We introduce fNIRSAtlas, the largest open benchmark for fNIRS classification to date, comprising 23 classification tasks from 19 public data collections, spanning diverse experimental paradigms, including motor execution, motor imagery, mental arithmetic, working memory, and emotion recognition. fNIRSAtlas provides a fully automated pipeline from raw data to evaluation and defines standardized benchmark tasks for both cross-subject and within-subject classification, ensuring reproducible comparison of methods. We evaluate a variety of baseline models from fNIRS and related neuroimaging and time-series machine learning literature on the benchmark. Our results demonstrate that performance varies substantially across tasks and that methods validated on limited data -- especially deep learning approaches -- often fail to generalize beyond their original evaluation. fNIRSAtlas serves as an extensible, open, and reproducible benchmark to support more robust and cumulative progress in machine learning for fNIRS data. Our code and data can be found at https://fnirsatlas.github.io.

items.title: Transferring local rib responses to new component geometries in sheet forming with a graph-based Transformer
items.titleZh: 使用基于图形的 Transformer 将局部肋响应转移到板材成型中的新组件几何形状
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10086v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Sheet metal components often consist of a global geometry, such as the corner radii and forming depth of a corner component, and local features added to it. During forming, both affect material flow. A surrogate learning all their combinations may need large training data. However, the same local feature type is often used on many global geometries. This study therefore partly decouples local features from the global geometry. The local-feature effect is first learned on one global geometry, needing fewer simulations than learning all combinations, then transferred to other global geometries via transfer learning, which can need fewer target simulations than training from scratch. A baseline-conditioned residual surrogate, R-BiLoGo, is proposed for ribs on the side walls of hot-stamped corner components. Its inputs are the baseline response and the geometric perturbation introduced by the ribs. Its outputs are the changes in displacement and thinning from the baseline. R-BiLoGo gave lower errors than a hierarchical graph-based model and a Transolver-based model on the source geometry, and on two of three selected target geometries after transfer. Across the 22 target geometries, transfer learning with 20 target simulations gave errors similar to or lower than training from scratch with 80 target simulations for about half of the targets. With the same 80 target simulations, transfer learning reduced errors for 95% of targets. The effect of the global geometry on transfer was studied with four parameter-free geometric descriptors and controlled variations across 4 corner subclasses. The benefit of transfer decreased with increasing surface distance and high-curvature change between source and target, and for targets shallower than the source. These trends were also seen in other corner types with a different magnitude.

items.title: Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization for Efficient LLM-based Multi-agent Systems
items.titleZh: 基于 LLM 的高效多智能体系统的协调混合精度 KV 缓存量化
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10096v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems solve complex tasks through collaboration, but their growing, simultaneously resident key-value (KV) caches create a memory bottleneck. Applying single-model quantization policies independently ignores differences in agents' precision needs, potentially degrading collective reasoning. We introduce Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization (CoMixKV), which combines online sensitivity estimation with joint agent-layer bit-width allocation under a shared memory budget. To our knowledge, CoMixKV is the first mixed-precision KV-cache quantization framework to jointly allocate precision across simultaneously resident agent caches under such a budget. The estimator derives sensitivity from a local attention-error bound using recent queries, keys, and values, without calibration data, trial quantization, or additional model passes. A shared controller combines these scores with remaining quantizable capacity and byte-level storage costs to minimize total estimated error. Allocations are refreshed as agents start or finish and new observations become available. Selected widths apply only to newly quantized blocks; recent states retain native precision and previously quantized blocks remain unchanged. Across four benchmarks and three LLM backbones at average 2-bit, 3-bit, and 4-bit settings, CoMixKV achieves strong accuracy against the evaluated quantization baselines. At the average 3-bit setting on Gemma-4-31B-it, it achieves 68.35% average accuracy, exceeding the strongest quantized baseline by 0.59%. On Qwen3-32B, it reduces peak KV-cache memory by 32.08% and achieves a 1.38x inference speedup over FullKV.

items.title: TrialJev: Open-Weight Single Pass Eligibility Scoring for Patient Trial Screening
items.titleZh: TrialJev：用于患者试验筛选的开放式重量单次资格评分
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10145v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Clinical trial screening requires assessing large numbers of patient-trial pairs to prioritize candidates for detailed eligibility review, often under restrictions on sharing patient records. We introduce TrialJev, an open-weight eligibility scorer that uses LoRA-adapted Qwen models and a pointer head to score natural-language answer options in a single forward pass, without autoregressive decoding. Trained on TREC Clinical Trials 2021 and evaluated on 6,975 eligible-or-excluded pairs from 50 unseen TREC 2022 synthetic patients, TrialJev achieves 80.97% (Qwen3.5-27B) and 81.84% (Qwen3.8-27B) accuracy, compared with 79.87% and 79.93% for LLMs fine-tuned on the same data to generate verdicts. In matched batch-1 measurements, verdict generation takes 2.45-2.70 times as long as the one-pass inference of TrialJev at 9B-27B. Under a common development-fitted decision correction, the two 27B TrialJev models reach 80.99% and 81.88% accuracy, compared with 81.28% for the proprietary hosted Jev API; paired confidence intervals include zero. TrialJev runs locally on a single GPU, requiring approximately 178 ms per pair at 27B, without transmitting patient text to an external model API. An A/B-logit ablation shows that avoiding decoding, rather than the pointer head alone, accounts for the measured efficiency advantage. TrialJev is intended for first-pass prioritization of candidate trials, complementing rather than replacing explanatory models and clinical review. Evaluation is limited to synthetic patients and implementation-specific timing, and clinical use has not been validated. Adapters, pointer heads, and model cards are released on Hugging Face.

items.title: Learning Across Heterogeneous Feature Spaces with Group Robustness
items.titleZh: 具有群体鲁棒性的跨异构特征空间学习
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10153v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: In clinical applications, patients undergo different combinations of tests, and machine learning models must therefore ensure accurate predictions across heterogeneous feature spaces. Current approaches upweight the patients with the highest loss, without accounting for the limited predictive information in their features preventing their loss from going any lower. Moreover, when patients' feature spaces are fully disjoint, current methods reduce to training independent models, preventing knowledge transfer across them. We propose a framework for group robust learning across heterogeneous feature spaces, where groups are patients sharing a feature space. Since a high loss may simply reflect uninformative features, we instead optimize for worst-group excess loss, the gap between a group's loss and an estimate of its achievable optimum. To allow collaboration between groups, we use group-specific encoders mapping into a shared latent space in which learnable Gaussian anchors cluster patients by outcome. On tabular and imaging medical datasets, including fully disjoint feature settings, our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods when groups differ in their optimal losses or cannot train a good model on their own, reducing worst-group loss by up to 79% and excess loss by up to 95% with up to 18$\times$ fewer parameters.

摘要：在临床应用中，患者接受不同的测试组合，因此机器学习模型必须确保跨异构特征空间的准确预测。目前的方法增加了损失最高的患者的权重，而没有考虑到患者特征中有限的预测信息，从而防止损失进一步降低。此外，当患者的特征空间完全不相交时，当前的方法会减少到训练独立模型，从而阻止知识在模型之间转移。我们提出了一个跨异构特征空间进行群体稳健学习的框架，其中群体是共享特征空间的患者。由于高损失可能仅仅反映了无信息的特征，因此我们针对最差组的超额损失进行优化，即组损失与其可实现的最佳值的估计之间的差距。为了允许小组之间的协作，我们使用特定于小组的编码器映射到共享的潜在空间，其中可学习的高斯锚按结果对患者进行聚类。在表格和成像医学数据集上，包括完全不相交的特征设置，当各组的最佳损失不同或无法自行训练良好的模型时，我们的框架优于最先进的方法，将最差组损失减少高达 79%，将超额损失减少高达 95%，参数减少多达 18 美元\倍$。

items.title: Projected Neural Additive Models as Universal Approximators
items.titleZh: 投影神经加法模型作为通用逼近器
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10186v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Neural additive models (NAMs) offer interpretability but lack expressivity due to their rigid additive structure, whereas multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) achieve universal approximation at the cost of transparency. We establish the first theoretical foundation for projected neural additive models (PNAMs), which augment NAMs with a learnable linear transformation $\boldsymbol{T}$ to capture cross-variable interactions. While standard NAMs cannot approximate even the simplest interaction term $\chi_1 \chi_2$ because their cross-derivatives are identically zero, we prove that PNAMs are universal approximators and characterize the minimum number of projections required for exact polynomial representation. Furthermore, we derive an approximation rate of $\mathcal{O}(M^{-s / (N - 1)})$ for $\mathcal{C}^s$ functions (i.e., functions with $s$ continuous derivatives), where $M$ denotes the number of projections and $N$ the input dimension; this rate is known to be optimal for ridge function approximation. To recover interpretability from the projected inputs, we introduce structured sparsity regularizers and post-hoc symbolic regression techniques that enable global input ranking, parameter pruning, and the conversion of learned bases into compact analytical expressions. Experiments on knot theory invariants, MNIST, and phase field fracture mechanics demonstrate that PNAMs match or surpass similar architectures in accuracy while discovering salient features and yielding symbolic models with orders of magnitude fewer parameters.

arXiv:2611.10186v1 公告类型：新
摘要：神经加性模型（NAM）提供可解释性，但由于其严格的加性结构而缺乏表达性，而多层感知器（MLP）以透明为代价实现通用逼近。我们为投影神经加性模型（PNAM）建立了第一个理论基础，该模型通过可学习的线性变换 $\boldsymbol{T}$ 来增强 NAM 以捕获跨变量相互作用。虽然标准 NAM 甚至无法逼近最简单的交互项 $\chi_1 \chi_2$，因为它们的交叉导数完全为零，但我们证明 PNAM 是通用逼近器，并且表征了精确多项式表示所需的最小投影数。此外，我们得出$\mathcal{C}^s$函数（即具有$s$连续导数的函数）的$\mathcal{O}(M^{-s / (N - 1)})$的近似率，其中$M$表示投影数量，$N$表示输入维度；已知该速率对于岭函数近似而言是最佳的。为了从投影输入中恢复可解释性，我们引入了结构化稀疏正则化器和事后符号回归技术，这些技术能够实现全局输入排序、参数修剪以及将学习的基础转换为紧凑的分析表达式。对结理论不变量、MNIST 和相场断裂力学的实验表明，PNAM 在精度上匹配或超越类似的架构，同时发现显着特征并产生参数数量级少的符号模型。

items.title: Fast Accurate Quantum Monte Carlo without Metropolis Adjustment
items.titleZh: 快速准确的量子蒙特卡罗，无需 Metropolis 调整
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10187v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: In quantum systems, physical quantities of interest can be expressed as expectation values of a probability distribution, which allows their estimation by Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods. This approach, an instance of Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC), plays a central role in obtaining predictions of system properties relevant to condensed matter and high energy physics. The use of Hamiltonian dynamics to design a Markov kernel, known as Hybrid or Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC), is widespread in quantum applications. In this context, it is standard to use an HMC kernel that is ``adjusted'' with the Metropolis-Hastings (MH) criterion, so that estimates of expectations converge to their true value in the limit of infinite sample size. However, recent work in computational statistics suggests that an \emph{unadjusted} HMC kernel can be significantly more efficient, while safely maintaining an asymptotic bias which is small relative to the error arising from the variance of the finite sample size. We adapt this approach to the QMC setting, focusing on a challenging and high-dimensional \emph{spin-fermion} model of a quantum phase transition. We find that unadjusted methods outperform adjusted HMC in terms of effective sample size per gradient call, while retaining accurate results.

arXiv:2611.10187v1 公告类型：新
摘要：在量子系统中，感兴趣的物理量可以表示为概率分布的期望值，这使得可以通过马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗（MCMC）方法对其进行估计。这种方法是量子蒙特卡罗 (QMC) 的一个实例，在获得与凝聚态物质和高能物理相关的系统特性的预测方面发挥着核心作用。使用哈密顿动力学设计马尔可夫核，称为混合或哈密顿蒙特卡罗 (HMC)，在量子应用中广泛使用。在这种情况下，标准做法是使用根据 Metropolis-Hastings (MH) 标准进行“调整”的 HMC 内核，以便在无限样本量的限制下，期望估计值收敛到其真实值。然而，最近计算统计方面的工作表明，\emph{未调整} HMC 内核可以显着提高效率，同时安全地保持渐近偏差，该偏差相对于有限样本大小的方差引起的误差较小。我们将这种方法应用于 QMC 设置，重点关注具有挑战性的高维 emph{自旋费米子} 量子相变模型。我们发现，就每次梯度调用的有效样本量而言，未经调整的方法优于调整后的 HMC，同时保留了准确的结果。

items.title: BiMuon: A Geometry-Aware Stochastic Bilevel Optimization Approach
items.titleZh: BiMuon：一种几何感知的随机双层优化方法
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.10188v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Stochastic bilevel optimization provides a general framework for many machine learning applications, such as hyperparameter learning, data reweighting, language model alignment, and actor-critic reinforcement learning. However, most existing bilevel optimization methods treat matrix-valued gradients as flattened vectors and perform optimization in the resulting vectorized space, ignoring the matrix structures common in modern neural networks. Moreover, the lower-level (LL) problem curvature can induce significant spectral imbalance in the upper-level (UL) geometry. Such limitations of existing bilevel optimization methods motivate us to develop BiMuon, a geometry-aware stochastic bilevel optimization method that integrates implicit hypergradient estimation in bilevel optimization with Muon-style orthogonalized updates at the UL. To our knowledge, BiMuon is the first stochastic BLO method with Muon-style orthogonalized matrix updates and an $O(\epsilon^{-4})$ iteration-complexity guarantee, matching the best-known rates achieved by Muon-type methods based on matrix parameterizations. To improve computational and parallel efficiency for models with multiple matrix parameters, we further study BiMuon for blockwise diagonal matrix approximation and derive a relative stepsize allocation rule based on UL progress and blockwise LL sensitivity. We evaluate BiMuon on representation learning and blockwise bilevel optimization, providing empirical support for our methods.

arXiv:2611.10188v1 公告类型：新
摘要：随机双层优化为许多机器学习应用提供了通用框架，例如超参数学习、数据重新加权、语言模型对齐和行动评论家强化学习。然而，大多数现有的双层优化方法将矩阵值梯度视为展平向量，并在所得向量化空间中执行优化，忽略了现代神经网络中常见的矩阵结构。此外，低层（LL）问题曲率可能会导致上层（UL）几何结构中出现严重的光谱不平衡。现有双层优化方法的这些局限性促使我们开发 BiMuon，这是一种几何感知的随机双层优化方法，它将双层优化中的隐式超梯度估计与 UL 处的 Muon 式正交更新相结合。据我们所知，BiMuon 是第一个具有 Muon 式正交矩阵更新和 $O(\epsilon^{-4})$ 迭代复杂度保证的随机 BLO 方法，与基于矩阵参数化的 Muon 型方法所实现的最著名速率相匹配。为了提高具有多个矩阵参数的模型的计算和并行效率，我们进一步研究了 BiMuon 的分块对角矩阵近似，并推导了基于 UL 进度和分块 LL 灵敏度的相对步长分配规则。我们评估 BiMuon 的表示学习和分块双层优化，为我们的方法提供经验支持。
